description: This file defines a SubmissionService class responsible for managing data product submissions, including creating submissions, ensuring minimal test submissions, retrieving submissions, and updating their states. It interacts with a database, audit service, draft service, and utility functions for ID generation and timestamps.

classes.name: SubmissionService
classes.description: Service class for managing submission lifecycle, including creation, retrieval, and state updates.

methods.name: ensure_minimal_submission_for_tests
methods.description: Creates minimal draft and submission entries for specific test IDs to facilitate deterministic testing.

methods.name: create_submission
methods.description: Creates a new submission from a draft, queues validation, and records audit events.

methods.name: get_submission
methods.description: Retrieves a submission record by its ID.

methods.name: update_state
methods.description: Updates the state of a submission and logs the change via audit events.
